How it works

From first call to finished.

Step 1

Consult & measure

We confirm each vehicle’s year, make, model and trim and photograph or template the panels we’ll cover.

Step 2

Design & proof

Our designers lay your branding out on a to-scale template. You approve a proof before anything is printed.

Step 3

Print & laminate

Printed in-house on cast wrap film (3M IJ180 or Avery MPI 1105) under a matching UV laminate.

Step 4

Install & inspect

Wrapped panel by panel in our climate-controlled bay, edges post-heated, then inspected with you.

Do you serve King City?
Yes. From King City it’s usually 20–30 minutes south via Highway 400, Keele Street or Dufferin Street to our shop. Everything is done at our shop at 50 Viceroy Rd, Unit 22–23, Vaughan, and we serve all of King Township, York Region.
How much does a commercial wrap cost in King City?
The same as at our shop for any GTA customer: full printed wraps start at $2,800 for a car, $3,950 for a Transit-size van, $5,800 for a box truck and $4,800 for a trailer, before HST. Lettering is about 22% of the full-wrap price, a partial wrap about 45% and a ¾ wrap about 70%.
How long does a commercial wrap last?
With cast film and laminate, expect around 5–7 years on vertical panels in Ontario weather and 3–5 years on roofs and hoods.
Can you wrap a leased vehicle?
Usually, yes — quality cast film removes cleanly from factory paint. Check your lease terms; we can remove the wrap before the vehicle is returned.
Do you design the wrap?
Yes. Our in-house designers build the layout on your vehicle’s template (design services: $250 + tax). You can also send print-ready artwork.
